description: Find ready-made, expert prompt templates for a work task in the thinkhard.si repository (500+ prompts for email, meetings, presentations, job search, marketing, sales, support, HR, finance, legal, spreadsheets, research and more). Use it whenever the user wants to write, plan, summarize, analyze or draft something at work, before writing a prompt from scratch. Then call get_prompt with the slug.

collection.description: Optional: limit to one collection (see list_collections).

limit.description: Optional: how many prompts to return, best match first (1 to 25, default 8).

model.description: Optional: only prompts laid out for this kind of model.

query.description: What the user wants to do, in plain words, for example "cover letter" or "summarize a long contract". Everyday words, abbreviations (CV, 1:1, P&L, SOP) and typos are understood, and results come best match first.

name: search_prompts

prompts.description: Best match first. Empty when nothing matches.

laid_out_for.description: The kind of model it is laid out for.

title: Search the prompt repository
